reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Anti-colonial claim to AI's benefits
themes.definition: AI framed as a product of human intelligence built on colonized peoples' resources, with demands that those peoples share in its benefits and warnings that AI in the hands of 'malevolent actors' becomes a weapon against peoples.
themes.inclusion: Include passages invoking colonial extraction, imperial actors or domination in relation to AI and demanding participation or restitution of benefits.
themes.exclusion: Exclude neutral access requests without a domination or anti-imperial framing (AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE).
themes.boundary_cases: Rhetoric describing AI as 'weapons of mass destruction' in the hands of hegemonic actors belongs here rather than AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS unless actual weapons systems are discussed.

examples.quote: Nicaragua demands the full participation of the peoples who have made those advances of the conquistadors possible with our blood and resources.
in the hands of the same malevolent actors as always, constitute weapons of mass destruction against countries, peoples and communities

themes.label: Right to enjoy AI development
themes.definition: Demand for inclusion and the right of peoples to enjoy the benefits of AI and technological development to improve work, study and life.
themes.inclusion: Include passages asserting a right to share AI benefits for living and working conditions.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages only criticizing power concentration without a benefit-sharing claim.
themes.boundary_cases: Skepticism about the term 'artificial intelligence' itself does not change coding if benefit-sharing is demanded.

examples.quote: We demand what is ours — the right to fully enjoy this development, improving the conditions of work, study and life of our peoples

value.rationale: Single Nicaraguan passage with an anti-colonial framing of AI: it questions the term, claims AI's benefits for peoples whose resources enabled it, and warns of AI as a weapon in hegemonic hands.
